comment: Day 5 CI merge safety: quality-gate now runs on pull_request with secret-backed gates disabled by default; auto-merge refuses risky release/auth/privacy paths and requires non-author cross-agent approval. Verified static CI safety test, workflow YAML parse, strict preflight, and diff check.

Day 6 release privacy surface: iOS Release Report flow is email-only, Talk Diagnostics/debug bundles are gated behind DEBUG/macOS, Quick Email contact usage is documented, and PrivacyInfo/App Store policy docs now declare Email Address plus OpenAI/ElevenLabs processing. Verified release privacy static test, plutil, strict preflight, diff check, and Release iOS simulator build.

Day 7 closure proof: V1 status remains 28/34, release preflight proves privacy/plist/iPhone-only/build checks pass and remains expected-red only for DEVELOPMENT_TEAM_ID, release APP_TOKEN, and entitlements confirmation. Verified strict preflight, release/privacy + CI safety tests, diff check, and appstore preflight.

Day 8 realtime production truth: production /realtime/client_secret refuses stub provider success and returns degraded 503 instead of local/test stub fallback; local deterministic failover remains green. Verified node --test backend/tests/realtime_client_secret_route.test.mjs, node --test backend/tests/realtime_supplier_failover.test.mjs, node scripts/pre_flight.mjs --strict, node scripts/v1_realtime_failover_smoke.mjs, node --check backend/lib/realtime_client_secret_route.js, node --check scripts/v1_manual_qa_checklist.mjs, git diff --check.

Day 9 realtime degraded UX: iOS now decodes production realtime degraded/unavailable envelopes as typed errors and falls back to Standard voice when Realtime Preview cannot bootstrap after a writer taps Talk. Verified focused degraded-envelope test, full BackendClientCraftAPITests slice on iPhone 17, strict preflight, and diff check.

Day 10 Studio restore reliability: stabilized mac debug project-load transport, DEBUG client-token override, sandbox-aware request mirrors, stale-token ack recovery, and dedicated project-selection API so backend/session restore smokes load the intended draft and reopened diff state. Verified JS checks, macOS harness build, iOS simulator build, backend restore smoke, relaunch restore smoke, and diff check.

Day 11 session bootstrap stability: coalesced concurrent BackendMemoryAPI /session bootstraps, persisted real client-token expiry/cache time, scoped recent token reuse by backend base URL, and added regression coverage for in-flight and cross-instance reuse. Verified focused BackendAccountDataControlsTests and diff check.

Day 11 Studio restore auth/session hardening: coalesced debug project owner handling across mirrored defaults, prevented duplicate/stale debug load failures, hardened large defaults writes, and tightened backend/relaunch restore smokes to require editor_ready with no load error.
